name: Large Sized Multi-Purpose Coop. Society: Medium Term Loan to Tribal Members
nodalDept: Co-operation, Food and Consumer Protection Department
briefDescription: The scheme offers medium-term loans of up to ₹60,000/- without interest to tribal members, enabling them to fulfill various financial needs.
descriptionMd:
The &quot;Large Sized Multi-Purpose Coop. Society: Medium Term Loan to Tribal Members&quot; scheme launched by the Co-operation, Food and Consumer Protection Department, Tamil Nadu, aims to provide a medium-term loan facility to tribal members through the Large Sized Multi Purpose Cooperative Society. The maximum loan amount is ₹60,000/- with no interest, making it a cost-effective financing option for the community.
<br>
benefitsMd: - **Access to Loan:** Loan up to ₹60,000/-.  - **Interest Rate:** No interest.
eligibilityMd:
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
  - The beneficiary should belong to the Tribal category.
  - The beneficiary should be a member of a Large Sized Multi Purpose Cooperative Society.
  - The beneficiary should be interested in availing Medium Term Loan from the Large Sized Multi Purpose Cooperative Society.

<br>
applicationMd:
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should collect the application form by contacting the Special Officer of the Large Sized Multi Purpose Cooperative Society.
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the concerned authority..
**Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, a unique identification number (if applicable).
<br>

> **Region-wise Address and Contact Information of Large Sized Multipurpose Cooperative Societies:** [https://www.rcs.tn.gov.in/mpd_cooperative_4.php](https://www.rcs.tn.gov.in/mpd_cooperative_4.php)
